coordinateReferenceSystem.note: NOT WGS84. [x, y] in canonical game units, origin LOWER-LEFT, +x right, +y UP. This is the single coordinate space shared by the LevelEditor, the Simulator and the game, and by the stored level geometry. Nothing rescales: use these numbers verbatim. Map artwork is exactly 2868x2064 in this same space.

style.note: Suggested paint values. Keys are matched category.kind, then category.

metadata.title: Lexington & Concord, 19 April 1775 - the British retreat

labels.note: Every visible feature carries properties.label. Draw label.text at label.anchor - canonical units, LOWER-left of the text box, +y up - using label.fontSizePx and label.fontWeight. The anchor always sits within 110px of the feature it names, so the label reads as belonging to it. Do NOT draw leader lines - there are none, and the text is already next to its feature.
labels.fontFamily: system sans (Arial / Helvetica); substitute the game's UI face
